about: Search descriptions, keyed by page kind then topic or unit id (docs/apprecalc-architecture.md). titles holds a shorter name for a <title> that would be cut.

notes.exp-log-inverses: Exponential and logarithmic functions with the same base are inverses: each undoes the other, and their graphs reflect across y = x. Free precalculus notes.
notes.matrices-as-functions: A 2 × 2 matrix as a function: its inputs and outputs are vectors, and it moves every point of the plane by the same rule. Free precalculus notes.
notes.parametric-circles-lines: How to write a circle or a line as a parametric function, trace it in a chosen direction and speed, and turn it back into an equation. Free precalculus notes.
notes.tangent-function: Tangent is sine divided by cosine: the slope of the terminal ray, with period π and vertical asymptotes where cosine is 0. Free precalculus notes.
